📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 prior_high：high.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).max().shift(1)
  2. 计算 recent_breakout：(close > prior_high).astype(float).滚动窗口(5, min_periods=1).max().shift(1)
  3. 计算 atr：alpha_tools.average_true_range(df_copy, window=20)
  4. 计算 day_range：(high - low)
  5. 计算 close_loc：((close - low) / day_range).clip(0, 1)
  6. 计算 rejection：(1.0 - close_loc)
  7. 计算 failure_depth：((prior_high - close).clip(lower=0) / atr)
  8. 计算 retest_failure：((low <= prior_high) & (close < prior_high)).astype(float)
  9. 计算 vol_ratio：(volume / volume.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()).clip(upper=3.0)
  10. 计算 daily_failure：retest_failure * failure_depth * rejection * vol_ratio
  11. 计算 recent_failure：daily_failure.滚动窗口(5, min_periods=1).sum()
  12. 计算 signal：-recent_breakout * recent_failure
  13. 计算 signal：signal.where(np.isfinite(signal), 0.0)

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_failed_retest_reversion_20_5(df): """Idea: After an upside breakout, a retest that fails to hold the prior 20-day high (price touches the boundary ">class="kw">and closes back below it) carries reversion information: repeated failed retests with elevated volume ">class="kw">and closes near the lows separate a failed attempt that reverts into the range ">class="kw">from a genuine level-hold. Logic: recent_breakout flags any close above the prior 20-day high "kw">class="kw">in the last five days (shifted). retest_failure marks days where low <= prior_high "kw">class="kw">and close < prior_high. failure_depth is the distance of the close below the prior high normalized by ATR20. rejection is 1 - close location, so closes near the low receive the strongest rejection weight. volume ratio is capped at 3. The daily failure score is summed over five days to capture repeated failed attempts. The raw signal is negative, expressing expected reversion, "kw">class="kw">and is only active after a recent upside breakout. Sub-mechanism tags: failed_retest, breakout_reversion, close_rejection, volume_confirmation """ df_copy = df.copy() prior_high = df_copy["high"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).max().shift(1) recent_breakout = (df_copy["close"] > prior_high).astype(float).rolling(5, min_periods=1).max().shift(1) atr = alpha_tools.average_true_range(df_copy, window=20) day_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).replace(0.0, np.nan) close_loc = ((df_copy["close"] - df_copy["low"]) / day_range).clip(0, 1) rejection = (1.0 - close_loc).fillna(0.0) failure_depth = ((prior_high - df_copy["close"]).clip(lower=0) / atr.replace(0.0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0) retest_failure = ((df_copy["low"] <= prior_high) & (df_copy["close"] < prior_high)).astype(float) vol_ratio = (df_copy["volume"] / df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(upper=3.0).fillna(1.0) daily_failure = retest_failure * failure_depth * rejection * vol_ratio recent_failure = daily_failure.rolling(5, min_periods=1).sum().fillna(0.0) signal = -recent_breakout * recent_failure signal = signal.where(np.isfinite(signal), 0.0) signal.name = "factor_failed_retest_reversion_20_5" "kw">class="kw">return signal
